subject: Mobile Development
title: The SIM Card Revolution
description: A quick, practical guide to The SIM Card Revolution.

hook.text: Before SIM cards, your phone number was locked to one specific phone.

buildup.text: The GSM standard introduced SIM cards — a tiny chip holding your identity.

discovery.text: Pop out the SIM, put it in a new phone, and your number moves with you instantly.

twist.text: Carriers hated it. SIM portability made it easy for customers to switch providers.

climax.text: SIM cards gave power to consumers and created real competition among carriers.

punchline.text: A chip the size of a fingernail freed users.

quiz.question: What did SIM cards allow users to do?
options: Move their number to a new phone
